register_model_with_decorator: use the registry.register_model decorator to register a new model class under a unique name key
register_task_with_decorator: use the registry.register_task decorator to register a new task class under a unique name key
get_registered_class_by_name: use registry.get_model_class or get_task_class to look up a registered class by its name or full import path
register_generic_state_value: use registry.register to store an arbitrary value under a dotted key path in the registry state
get_or_unregister_state_value: use registry.get to retrieve a stored value by dotted key or registry.unregister to remove it
